name: IBM 305 RAMAC with IBM 350 disk storage
summary: IBM's 305 RAMAC accounting system came with the 350, a stack of spinning magnetic disks that let a business computer fetch any stored record directly.
description: IBM 305 RAMAC accounting system with IBM 350 rotating magnetic-disk random-access storage.
